summary: Self-hostable platform for building AI agents and knowledge-base chatbots with a visual drag-and-drop workflow editor.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: FastGPT is a platform for building AI agents and knowledge-base Q&A apps. It handles document processing and model calls for you, and lets you design complex flows visually. Knowledge bases accept txt, md, html, pdf, docx, pptx, csv and xlsx files plus URLs, with hybrid retrieval and reranking.
sixtySeconds.problem: Building a chatbot over your own documents, with workflows and tools, usually takes a lot of custom code. FastGPT gives you a ready platform with a visual editor.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a mature knowledge base, visual workflow orchestration with MCP support, debugging tools and one-click embedding.

overview: Run the install script to pull the configuration files, then start everything with docker compose up -d. FastGPT is then at localhost:3000 with the default account root and password 1234; change it right away.
You can also use the hosted cloud version at fastgpt.io, deploy with Sealos, or buy a commercial version with more features and support.
It uses the FastGPT Open Source License, based on Apache 2.0: commercial use as a backend is allowed, but running it as a SaaS is not without authorization.
